category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.rationale: Exact anti-dandruff positioning and Piroctone Olamine at position 10 independently support the dandruff route. The exact manufacturer positioning separately names oily scalp, and SLES plus TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate provide a cleansing route independent of Piroctone Olamine.

category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.cle.rationale: Strong: SLES is reinforced by a second anionic sulfonate route and an oily-scalp/problem-led architecture, while CAPB and care routes do not fully offset the reset chassis. Observed intensity: regular.

product.suitable_thicknesses.rationale: Ideal: fine — Moderate conditioning and weight offset some of the strong cleansing chassis without creating a heavy fine-hair default. normal — The treatment architecture combines recognized dandruff support with moderate conditioning and weight for normal-diameter hair. coarse — The anti-dandruff treatment role is diameter-independent, and the silicone/cationic care routes make the strong cleansing architecture usable for coarse hair. Conditional (not emitted): none.

required_protocol_roles.rationale: Roles derived from reviewed buckets: shampoo_dandruff, shampoo_everyday.

research.properties.cleansingStrength.rationale: Strong: SLES is reinforced by a second anionic sulfonate route and an oily-scalp/problem-led architecture, while CAPB and care routes do not fully offset the reset chassis.

research.properties.conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: silicone gum, dimethicone, cationic guar and glycol distearate should provide noticeable slip, but the strong anti-dandruff cleansing chassis keeps care bounded.

research.properties.dandruffSupport.rationale: Supported: the complete formula contains Piroctone Olamine, one of the two v1.4 recognized anti-dandruff actives.

research.properties.focusPrimary.rationale: Scalp active: this is a problem-led anti-dandruff product and the formula contains Piroctone Olamine at position 10.

research.properties.focusSecondary.rationale: Clarifying is a secondary: the packet separately names oily scalp, and the formula has a strong cleanser plus second anionic route independent from the dandruff active.

research.properties.scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Targeted: the product explicitly addresses dandruff-related itching and scalp problems and includes a recognized active, with panthenol/niacinamide as comfort-adjacent support.

research.properties.usageRole.rationale: Treatment: v1.4 routes problem-led recognized active formulas, especially anti-dandruff support, to treatment usage.

research.properties.weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: silicone gum, dimethicone and cationic guar can leave bounded residue, while strong reset architecture argues against high weight.
